issues.reason: The genitive rule explicitly excludes an about/content of-phrase ("a photo of Mary") from Possession, and Possession is possessed-first, so (Possession sk_count_1 burial_service_fraud) makes the fraud the count's possessor — false; the licensed carrier is the entity-attached surface-preposition oblique, which the *Complements of nouns and adjectives* section says "records the aboutness and nothing else".
Same defect on the second count — Possession where the of-phrase names what the count charges; repaired to (Of sk_count_2 make_false_statement).
Same defect on the third count; repaired to (Of sk_count_3 sk_abuse_1), matching the parse's own (Of sk_abuse_1 sk_body_1).
Same defect on the fourth count; repaired to (Of sk_count_4 theft).

*Compound concepts* says decompose "to single-word lemmas" and that the head genus is "always emitted either way", so a compound left in the Patient slot still owes (Inheritance false_statement statement); and since "false" is an adjective predicable of the thing ("the statement is false"), the modifier genus is determined, not optional.

gaps_confirmed: a gerund-headed action NP used as a free-standing charge name ("making false statements") — the compound-action shape is specified only for an action term inside a reified (can ...) / (obligated ...) / (permitted ...) property
a bare numeric appositive age ("Ray Brent Marsh, 29,") — Measure needs a stated dimension, so scale old and unit year come from world knowledge
"multiple" as a vague-quantity phrase — not among the listed CardinalityPhrase words, so whether it is a canonical lexicon string that maps to a bound is unspecified
a coordinated list of charges under one "multiple counts of ..." — nothing says whether each conjunct gets its own count individual or whether the of-phrase attaches to the counts group
new_gaps: whether a COMPOUND occupying a decomposition slot must itself be decomposed is ambiguous — "decompose once ... then stop" reads one level deep, while "decompose to single-word lemmas" and the always-emitted genus require bottoming out (this repair takes the latter reading for false_statement)
repair_summary: Replaced the four (Possession sk_count_N <offense>) atoms with the entity-attached oblique (Of sk_count_N <offense>); added the missing decomposition of false_statement — genus (Inheritance false_statement statement) and modifier genus (Inheritance false_statement false).
notes: Left untouched as correct: charges asserted without guilt, the untensed stative-transitive "faces" with Agent + Theme, the age Measure unwrapped under a present-tense host, and the split "dead body" typing.
